coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Irish Hill Playground and Irish Hill Corner Plaza
record.summary: The roughly two-acre courtyard park beside the Irish Hill remnant, bounded by Parcels C1, C2, PKS, HDY1/2 and HDY3 (D4D Section 3.12), with the smaller Irish Hill Corner Plaza at Illinois and 22nd Streets (Section 3.11) as its gateway. The 2017 DDA lets the City ask the Hoedown Yard developer to build 'Irish Hill Park' with special-tax proceeds; nothing has been built and its Hoedown Yard neighbors remain in PG&E ownership.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE -- traced directly from Figure 6.4.2's own 'Public Open Space' fill color (programmatic color-region contour extraction), then clipped against PKS/HDY3/C1/C2/HDY1-2's own committed geometries. Now extends north to touch '21ST ST (NEW)' directly in the gap between PKS and C1, matching the diagram's own drawn fill. Rendered as a MultiPolygon: a small, genuinely separate piece near Illinois St (the Irish Hill Corner Plaza zone) does not touch the main body in the diagram.
notes.digitized_from: Pier 70 Design for Development, Figure 6.4.2 - Maximum Building Height (p.155); named per Figure 3.4.1 - Overview of Public Spaces (p.52), zones 7 and 8.
notes.why_no_real_parcel: Open space with no subdivided Assessor parcel of its own within Brookfield's largely unaddressed 28-acre site.
notes.regulatory_context: Part of the Pier 70 D4D's Open Space Network (Section 3.4): Irish Hill Playground (Section 3.12, ~2.0 acres), described as an open space adjacent to the existing remnant of Irish Hill (Section 3.2) -- a small rock outcrop, the last visible remnant of a larger hill largely quarried away in the early 20th century for shipyard construction. Irish Hill Corner Plaza (Section 3.11) is a separate, smaller named zone at the southwest corner of this same open area, near the Illinois St/22nd St corner.

facts.value: 3.12 Irish Hill Playground (zone 8) and 3.11 Irish Hill Corner Plaza (zone 7) of Figure 3.4.1; the Irish Hill remnant itself is Section 3.2 'Historic Landscape'
approximately 2.0 for the playground (D4D Section 3.4); Irish Hill landform about 1.5 acres (2013 Port fact sheet)

Playground for all ages (minimum 10,000 sq ft, G3.12.1) with at least two universally accessible entries from Illinois and 22nd Streets, picnic grove (minimum 50 ft wide), seating area along the north edge of HDY1/2, viewing terrace west of the Irish Hill remnant; a small dog run may be added; public restrooms to be considered

Entry plaza at least 40 ft wide along 22nd and Illinois and at least 2,000 sq ft (S3.11.1), with interpretive elements on Irish Hill's history, a seating terrace and a passage to the playground; plantings kept low to preserve the view of the remnant's peak

The remnant is what survived of the hill leveled for the shipyard: the 2014 NRHP nomination says Building 12 was constructed 'on newly leveled ground where most of Irish Hill once stood' and that Building 2's land 'was formerly occupied by a portion of Irish Hill'
C1, C2, PKS, HDY1/2 and HDY3
May be built by the Hoedown Yard developer at the City's request (2017 DDA terms); otherwise part of the developer's park obligations

open_questions: No design approval, construction contract or completion for the playground or corner plaza was found; the site depends on the City's unexercised option on the PG&E Hoedown Yard and on Parcel K South, neither of which has moved.

How much of Irish Hill was quarried, when, and by whom is not stated in the retrieved primary sources beyond the NRHP nomination's site descriptions; the geometry file's 'quarried away in the early 20th century' summary is unsourced here.
This record combines two D4D zones (3.11 and 3.12) into one geometry, per the geometry file's caveat.

No basis for an expected-completion date was found: the 2017 DDA's Schedule of Performance ties Irish Hill Park's outside date to 1-1.5 years after the last temporary certificate of occupancy for HDY1 or HDY2 ('a Port or Hoedown Yard Vertical Developer obligation, at Port's discretion,' Port Commission Item 9B, Sept 22, 2017, Table A, p.8), but the Hoedown Yard itself is outside the 28-Acre Project and has no reported schedule (see the HDY1/2 and HDY3 records), so no window can be dated here.
